_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Woyɛ Odwumayɛni {player_id} wɔ Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Wo akyerɛ ne '{symbol}'.
Wɔbɛkyerɛ wɔn akyerɛ wɔ 5x5 board so sɛnea wɔbɛnya gyinabea a ɛyɛ anan.
Gyinabea no betumi ayɛ ɔfa, ɔfa a ɛyɛ nkyɛn, anaa ɔfa a ɛyɛ mɛnsa.
Fa w'akyi no wɔ '[4]' mu sɛnea wɔbɛkyerɛ kɔɔto 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkyerεkyerεmu a enni mu. Fa '[cell]' di dwuma bere a ɔfese no yɛ 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nkutoo a ɛnsɛe: {cell}. Ɛtɔ mmere biara a ɛwɔ 0 ne {max_cell} ntam.

game_action.placed: Ɔbɔfo {player_id} de ne ho agyirae ({symbol}) wɔ fie ({row}, {col}).
